specs.title: every caption addresses a control that exists
no id is used twice on a page
geometry is whole-pixel where it has to be
a skeleton reserves exactly what its content will occupy
a menu opens with the keyboard, moves with arrows, and closes with Escape
an accordion opens and closes from the keyboard
a tab strip moves with arrow keys, not only with clicks

a card that is one link covers itself, and nothing else
a select opens, moves with arrows, commits, and returns focus
escape closes a select without committing
a dialog contains focus and gives it back
a date picker can be driven from the keyboard alone
a list reorders from the keyboard, on the axis its label promises
a portal host keeps a popup inside its scope
